title: mrb_mod_visibility hands a NULL method table to mt_put after a prepend
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 03f242d09 (03f242d09ab21244b1405984d0e0d97cb7dc5dcc) (2026-08-24), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: a report my first pattern missed (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: a report my first pattern missed); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it

virtual-malloc.oracle: virtual profile, mruby 4.0.0-rc2 as ported on musl mallocng (exact bounds, lifetime retirement on free); its GC object slots are unbounded offsets in a malloc'd heap page: a capability fault (cause 24-30) is CAUGHT, a run that completes is MISSED

virtual-nested-pools.oracle: the same with patch 0008 (MRBD_SUBLET=1): every GC object slot a CDERIVE child of its heap page, revoked by CREVOKE when the sweep frees it: as virtual-malloc

status: sysalloc-none and sysalloc-bounds measured 2026-10-06 on the Capstone application VM; cheribsd-revocation measured 2026-10-06 on CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation at its default; virtual-malloc and virtual-nested-pools measured 2026-10-11 on the virtual profile. The sublet-gc arm left the case with the Sublet heap and the GC-slot adapter on 2026-10-11; its readings stay in results/20261006.
